script_text: PISCES — The Moon Will Not Rest Until You Completely Surrender To Its Deep Tides. Venus trines Scorpio in the 9th House for Pisces this month, creating unexpected romantic revelations and deeply profound emotional connections. Venus moves into Cancer, bringing profoundly deep emotional depth but also potential jealousy and possessiveness in intimate relationships. Jupiter expands opportunities while Saturn demands discipline; significant financial flows increase through new carefully considered partnerships and prudent investments. Mars squares Capricorn in the 7th House, challenging physical stamina and endurance during demanding close interpersonal engagements. August 28 sees a powerful Neptune square Pluto in the 4th House; September 15 brings Mercury retrograde through the 2nd House, significantly affecting finances and overall self-worth today. Avoid making impulsive decisions during the full moon on August 19 when Neptune's confusion clouds judgment and distorts reality. Embrace this transformation and trust your intuitive wisdom fully.
